Caption: _As of October 14, 2026  |  CoinGecko, Alternative.me, SoSoValue_

## 📡** THIS WEEK IN CRYPTO**

**GM, Readers!**

Uptober turns sour. BTC crashed from $85.5K to $81K on Oct 7-8 amid back-to-back BTC ETF outflows totaling $731.2M in 48 hours. Even BlackRock’s IBIT bled, and the US government moved 12,267 BTC worth $1.01B from wallets tied to the 2016 Bitfinex seizure.

_**Let’s get into it...**_


----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/6c53930f-b4d7-4e7d-baee-6a88bb56a6da/image.png?t=1781097813)
Caption: 

----------
# 🐋 THE BIG WHALE MOVES

### **1. US Govt Moves $1B of Bitfinex-Hack BTC**

On Oct 8, on-chain trackers like Lookonchain[ flagged](https://x.com/lookonchain/status/2108203900105113988) 12,267 BTC ($1.01B) leaving wallets tied to the US government seizure of the 2016 Bitfinex hack. Earlier on Oct 7, Arkham[ reported](https://x.com/arkham/status/2107879897180078495) a $470M transfer of BTC, USDT, and WBTC (from Bitfinex and Alameda-related seizures) to likely Coinbase Prime deposit addresses

**Whale Intel: **Movement is not selling. But a $1B transfer during a drawdown is the kind of overhang that caps rallies. Watch for a follow-on hop to a known exchange cluster.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/26804ccb-345b-4fe7-995d-b56eb2c8568b/image.jpeg?t=1791955292)
Caption: _Source: CoinDesk, Arkham, Oct 8, 2026_

### **2. Strategy Adds Another 250 BTC**

Strategy[ acquired](https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltf8d808d9b8cebd37/blte419037cd092e319/6acc004404e85227007cf7c7/strategy-acquires-250-btc-and-repurchases-192-million-of-strc_10-12-2026.pdf) 250 BTC for $21.5M at an average price of $86,194 between Oct 5 and Oct 11, lifting total holdings to 848,250 BTC. The company also repurchased $192M of its STRC preferred stock in the same window.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/1e7bb931-b884-46b7-a7a6-cea0539aca7a/image.jpeg?t=1791955292)
Caption: _Source: Strategy X Post (_[@Strategy](https://x.com/Strategy/status/2109615797584711760)_)_

**Whale Intel: **Even at a slower weekly pace, the largest corporate Bitcoin holder continues stacking. Small consistent buys still matter when you already control more than 4% of supply.
